integrity: The source defining set is reconstructed through exact cyclotomic closure. The generator polynomial, all codewords, self-orthogonality, projective columns, generalized weights, and minimum-support orbit are checked by exact finite arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the explicit quinary self-orthogonal cyclic \([24,3,19]\) code from Example 4.13 only. It does not classify all optimal codes with the same ordinary parameters.
title: The optimal quinary self-orthogonal cyclic \([24,3,19]\) code is projective three-weight
